profile.name: Fieldwork Studio
profile.summary: Brand identity and website design for small businesses.
profile.description: A fictional design studio used to demonstrate a business profile and an optional workspace setup.
profile.audience: Small businesses preparing a new website or brand identity.

plan.summary: Offer a defined set of design services with written scopes and review stages.
plan.customerAcquisition: Choose a customer type, prepare clearly labeled sample work, and add potential customers you have selected yourself.
plan.delivery: Use a customer brief, agree the scope, prepare drafts, collect feedback, and hand over final files.
plan.operations: Review enquiries, capacity, and current work each week.
assumptions: The owner supplies their own skills, equipment, customers, and company details.
requirements: Define available time and service scope before accepting work.
reviewCriteria: Review whether enquiries fit the offer and whether the delivery plan matches available time.

tasks.title: List the services you will offer
tasks.description: Record deliverables and exclusions for each service.
tasks.completionCriterion: A service list states what is included and excluded.

tasks.title: Adapt the customer brief
tasks.description: Ask for goals, audience, deliverables, deadline and decision-maker.
tasks.completionCriterion: The brief includes each required question.

tasks.title: Add your own potential customers
tasks.description: Select businesses you would like to work with and add their contact details yourself.
tasks.completionCriterion: The workspace contains potential customers selected by you.

milestones.title: Service offer prepared
milestones.description: The service list and customer brief are ready to use.
milestones.completionCriterion: The owner has reviewed both documents.
